investigations.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
investigations.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis (A2): Formose and Reductive-TCA Routes
investigations.objective: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?
investigations.claim: Endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted under vent conditions across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Endogenous autocatalysis — formose keystone arm (og-29, canonical)
Reductive-TCA autocatalysis (vent-fed) — branched-v2 arm (og-rtca)
Reductive-TCA degree-preserving matched null (equal feeds) — og-rtca matched null

investigations.name: og-carbon-fixation
investigations.title: Carbon Fixation: Does H2 Reduce CO2 at the Vent?
investigations.objective: Does H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S catalysts fix carbon and reproduce lab yield benchmarks at the vent — and can the model classes agree on which limitation stops it?
investigations.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction fixes carbon at the vent. Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate ~200 mM >> acetate ~100 uM >> pyruvate ~10 uM) and sustains net organic-carbon flux in a bounded pH-gradient x dissolved-H2 region; formate collapses to <1 mM in every no-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst control, and carbon fixation spends the proton gradient (~2 H+/carbon, chemiosmotic backpressure) (og-01, canonical, supported). Under explicit electrochemistry the vent cell is activation (catalyst) limited where the wall conducts and its current sits in the Altair-2025 window, but the two model classes agree on the dominant-limitation label on only 47% of the favorable region (below the pre-registered 80% gate), so the limitation attribution is structure-sensitive and og-01-cal-electrochemistry is refuted on that agreement question (og-01-cal, refuted; og-01-cal-dx planned to diagnose). Consolidated headline: supported — carbon fixation works and reproduces lab benchmarks; the mechanistic attribution of its rate-limiting step is not yet model-class-robust. Every matched null and arm verdict kept, including the refutation.
baseline_names: Hydrothermal carbon fixation — favorable, canonical (og-01)
No-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst matched null (og-01) — formate collapses <1 mM
Explicit electrochemical interface — Butler-Volmer + empirical classes (og-01-cal arm, refuted)

investigations.name: og-ecology
investigations.title: Protocell Ecology: Community Function Before the Complete Cell
investigations.objective: Is protocell-era chemistry ecological before it is cellular — does a cross-feeding community out-produce the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding), does community function precede cell completeness and vanish without exchange — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Protocell-era chemistry is ecological before it is cellular. A stochastic cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage with the margin causally attributable to cross-feeding and coexistence stabilized (not assumed), though the community is NOT more robust than monoculture and low-count stochasticity materially changes outcomes (og-36, qualified); a connected metacommunity beats an isolated control with cross-feeding robustness and closed ledgers (og-07, supported); and real metabolite exchange makes community function PRECEDE cell completeness and VANISH without exchange, segregated placement keeping function (og-07-alt, supported). Headline verdict qualified; every matched null and every arm verdict preserved.
baseline_names: Stochastic protocell ecology (community vs best single, matched null) — canonical arm (og-36)
Cross-feeding metacommunity (connected vs isolated) — og-07 arm
Real metabolite-exchange community (function before cell completeness) — og-07-alt arm

investigations.name: og-energetics
investigations.title: Proto-Energetics: Capture, Internalization, and Carrier Coupling
investigations.objective: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, a protocell's energetics buy robustness/persistence, not raw throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store with a closing ledger (proto-energetics arm, supported); a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a Sojo-bounded survival region (internalization arm, supported); which coupling chemistry pays is structure-sensitive and membrane-leak-dependent (5-class alt arm, supported, classes agree ~46%); and a specified thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves but does NOT improve total useful work (sharpened Gate-E arm, og-35, qualified). The consolidated headline is bounded by that sharpest arm: qualified, dip-persistence not throughput. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Chemical energy coupling (thioester carrier) — canonical headline arm (og-35)
Gradient-only null (no carrier store, equal drive/load) — og-35 matched null
Proto-energetics carrier capture (og-energy-proto arm)
Bioenergetic internalization under selection (og-05 arm)
Internalization-threshold 5-class sweep (og-energy-alt arm)

investigations.name: og-heredity
investigations.title: Chemical Heredity and Selection
investigations.objective: Does the protocell transmit an inherited chemical difference that carries selectable information at a feasible cost and produces a reproducible fitness difference against a no-inheritance control — and at what fidelity (compositional vs template)?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, an inherited chemical difference in the protocell is transmitted and selectable. Competing modules show heredity need not presume a long RNA template and that compositional / hybrid inheritance escapes the Eigen length catastrophe (og-06, supported); the information-per-cost frontier resolves which mechanisms transmit heritable bits per joule, attachment conditional on budget (og-06-alt, supported); and a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference — parent-offspring correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, with the population shifting under selection (og-34, qualified, canonical). Consolidated headline: qualified, compositional inheritance; template copying is the og-34a follow-up. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Chemical heredity & selection — inheritance arm (canonical, og-34)
No-inheritance matched null (og-34)
Competing inheritance modules (og-06 arm)
Information-per-cost frontier, six mechanisms (og-06-alt arm)

investigations.name: og-independence
investigations.title: Escape and Progressive Independence from the Vent
investigations.objective: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born protocell lineage reaches GRADED, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing (and not a free) escape. og-08 withdrew gradient + mineral + feed JOINTLY and found a coordinated innovation set {internal pump, importer, heredity} where any single removal collapses persistence — but joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so that general minimal-sufficiency reading is rescoped to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis (supported within its one coarse model). og-08-alt-robust then tests the minimum-sufficient set ACROSS model structures and returns an honest negative: no subset is jointly sufficient at the nominal ocean floor; driver-specifically, pump + heredity are where anything persists and the active importer is a net cost under a leaky membrane. og-37 resolves the attribution by withdrawing each support ONE AT A TIME with a matched per-support ablation: each channel is internalizable with the full set and causally attributed (gradient<-pump, mineral<-importer, feed<-importer), heredity is the irreducible substrate, and the gradient channel is budget-sensitive (internalization flips to a hard dependency below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in the energy arm's persistence-not-throughput surplus). Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Progressive independence (all-at-once, full innovation set) — canonical headline arm (og-37)
One-at-a-time per-channel withdrawal (the attribution novelty) — og-37
Escape from the vent (joint all-at-once relaxation) — og-08 foundation arm
Integrated autonomy — minimum-sufficient set across structures (honest negative) — og-08-alt-robust

investigations.name: og-network-persistence
investigations.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
investigations.objective: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persists — it sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (og-02, canonical, supported) — but its persistence is driven, not autocatalytic self-amplification. Graded by a common detector, og-02's curated rTCA motif is imposed and element-unbalanced (the apparent gain an artifact); the rule-generated open universe (121 species, 413 balanced reactions) sustains a 14-species persistent network with NO autocatalytic motif at the vent feed, because every C-C-forming route is uphill, and the single motif that emerges (formose) requires an exogenous formaldehyde feed the vent chemistry does not make (og-02-alt, supported, p=0.04 vs 24 matched nulls). A versioned, provenance-tracked reaction atlas with a zero-leakage write gate supplies the balanced, confidence-tiered reactions both arms draw on (og-28, supported). Consolidated headline: supported — the network persists; endogenous autocatalysis is refuted at vent feed and tracked as the og-autocatalysis line. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Curated minimal carbon-fixing network — canonical (og-02)
No-CO2-feed matched null (og-02) — network collapses without the carbon source
Rule-generated open chemical universe at the vent posterior (og-02-alt arm)
Provenance-gated reaction atlas (og-28 arm)

investigations.name: og-nutrient-bottlenecks
investigations.title: Nutrient Bottlenecks: Nitrogen and Phosphorus Keep Pace with Carbon
investigations.objective: Do the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks clear at the vent — does reduced nitrogen (ammonium) keep pace with carbon fixation, and does reactive phosphorus co-concentrate with carbon rather than precipitate — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: Neither of the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks blocks the vent pathway. Reduced nitrogen is produced as ammonium that is sustained and keeps pace with carbon fixation (setting a viable C:N), with the feature-ablation null producing none and nitrogen mass conserved (nitrogen arm, supported). Reactive phosphorus is available and co-concentrates with carbon in the pore, with an open-pore no-enrichment control showing no enrichment and P mass conserved (phosphorus arm, supported). Headline verdict supported; every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: Reduced-nitrogen reactor (ammonium, C:N balance) — canonical arm (og-res-nitrogen)
Phosphorus availability (reactive-P co-concentration) — og-res-phosphorus arm

investigations.name: og-reproduction
investigations.title: Reproduction: Coupled Growth and Division into a Lineage
investigations.objective: How does a self-maintaining protocell reproduce — does metabolism drive growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters (not lysis or starvation), building a multi-generation lineage, each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A self-maintaining protocell reproduces by metabolism-coupled growth and division into a lineage. Metabolism drives growth to a division at measured geometry with viable daughters, beating a null where growth is decoupled from metabolism or division is imposed (og-33, qualified); net throughput grows the compartment to division rather than lysis or starvation, mass-conserved, where a no-throughput ablation does not (og-growth-division, supported); and a growing, dividing individual builds a >=3-generation lineage with volume conserved across division (og-growth-alt, supported). Headline verdict qualified (coarse-grained geometry/budget abstraction); every matched null and every arm verdict preserved.
baseline_names: Chemically coupled growth and division — canonical arm (og-33)
Growth->division fate (vs no-throughput ablation) — og-growth-division arm
Physical reproduction to a multi-generation lineage — og-growth-alt arm

investigations.name: og-self-compartmentation
investigations.title: Self-Compartmentation: From Boundary to Self-Maintaining Protocell
investigations.objective: How does a vent-born chemical system acquire a self-made boundary and become a self-maintaining protocell — do amphiphiles assemble a retaining-but-not-isolating boundary, does encapsulation PAY against a matched equal-feed null, does the integrated compartment self-maintain and beat a matched ablation, and are real fatty-acid vesicles stable — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
investigations.claim: A vent-born system acquires a self-made boundary and self-maintains as a protocell, with the membrane buying persistence rather than raw throughput. Mixed fatty-acid/alcohol amphiphiles assemble into protocell boundaries in a vent window, giving individuality (retention) without full isolation and beating single-amphiphile controls (og-04, supported); a boundary also forms endogenously from the system's own carbon chemistry with a closed matter ledger (og-04-alt, supported); protometabolism-produced encapsulation PAYS against a matched equal-feed null on persistence and an access window but NOT on throughput, and the benefit is windowed (og-31, qualified); the integrated compartment self-maintains its membrane integrity and beats a matched ablation with MD-informed permeability (og-32, canonical, qualified); and real fatty-acid Martini-3 vesicles are stable across C10-C16 while a fully-charged null micellises at the short+charged corner, replacing og-32's phospholipid stand-in with a real amphiphile (og-32b, qualified — a short-MD fixed-charge stability trend, with the titratable/PMF gold standard tracked as og-32a). Headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.
baseline_names: First self-maintaining protocell (integrated, MD-informed) — canonical keystone arm (og-32)
Gate-C membrane benefit vs matched equal-feed null — og-31 arm
Mixed-amphiphile boundary assembly — og-04 foundation arm
Endogenous boundary from the system's own chemistry — og-04-alt arm
Real fatty-acid vesicle Martini MD (protonated vs charged null) — og-32b live-MD arm

investigations.name: og-spatial-concentration
investigations.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Make an Individual?
investigations.objective: Can vent pore physics concentrate a dilute vent feed strongly enough to form a persistent localized individual and ignite the reaction network productively — more than a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control at identical feeds?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities, vent pore physics concentrates a dilute feed into a persistent localized individual and ignites the reaction network. Resolving diffusion, thermophoresis, adsorption, surface catalysis and advection, a bounded serpentinite pore clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime (accumulation Peclet 18.4) and localizes a persistent individual vs a well-mixed control (og-03, supported). At identical vent-posterior feeds the concentrating pore ignites the full network — net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species — while a matched well-mixed, non-concentrating control stays dark (og-30, canonical, supported); the C6 network og-29 found needs ~20x well-mixed feed ignites directly in the pore at base feed. The pore benefit is a bounded porosity window, and network_connected is a brittle proxy near threshold (both kept honest). og-30 does double duty: it meets Gate B and resolves Gate A1's feed-plausibility. Consolidated headline: supported — spatial concentration makes the individual and rescues ignition. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Spatially integrated protometabolism in a concentrating pore — canonical (og-30)
Matched well-mixed, non-concentrating null (og-30) — stays dark at equal feed
Thermophoretic concentration physics (og-03 arm)

investigations.name: og-vent-environment
investigations.title: The Vent Environment: A Bounded but Viable Geochemical Reactor
investigations.objective: Is a serpentinizing Lost City-type vent a viable geochemical reactor that supplies the H2, inorganic carbon, pH/redox gradients and electrochemical driving force downstream chemistry needs — and within what bounds, as the mineral interface evolves and across the plausible range of vent states?
investigations.claim: Across fidelities the vent environment is a viable but bounded geochemical reactor. The serpentinizing reactor settles inside the Lost City window (50.6 C, pH 9.37, sustained H2) over ~80% of the operating grid — habitability is a bounded region, not one tuned run (og-00, supported). Conditioning on the Lost City field windows, 12.5% (6/48) of the empirically motivated prior reproduces all three observations and 100% of that posterior supplies the H2 + pH gradient downstream carbon fixation needs; dissolved H2 is the binding observation, pH is buffered and non-discriminating (og-cal, supported, calibrated). The sharpened coupled interface delivers H2 / inorganic-carbon flux + a maintained pH/redox gradient at or above required levels and a CO2-reducing electrochemical driving force, with mass/charge/energy closing across PHREEQC+FiPy+Reaktoro — but precipitation and passivation throttle supply on the mineral-evolution timescale and the supply<->throttle is a sharp two-regime DIC cliff, so delivery is bounded (og-27, canonical, qualified). Consolidated headline: qualified — a viable vent reactor within a bounded window, supplying downstream chemistry conditionally. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Coupled geochemical reaction interface — canonical (og-27)
Serpentinizing vent reactor baseline (og-00 arm)
Geochemical world at the vent-calibration operating point (og-cal arm)

investigations.name: og-vent-specificity
investigations.title: Vent Specificity: Are the Gates Vent-Specific or Generic?
investigations.objective: Do the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would any generic non-equilibrium drive pass them?
investigations.claim: The campaign's discriminating gates are specific to the serpentinizing alkaline vent, not to generic non-equilibrium. Run with the vent's characteristic features ablated (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst, no pore concentration), the same real og-01/02/03 composites fail all five gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet, enrichment) while the vent passes each — the generic-nonequilibrium null is refuted by every gate (og-adv, canonical; verdict=refuted = null correctly rejected, gate_status=passed = the control discriminates). A planned competing-environments study extends the falsification. Consolidated: the gates detect THIS vent, not any drive — specificity demonstrated via a refuted-by-design null. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
baseline_names: Generic non-vent adversarial control (ablated: no sustained H2 / no Fe-Ni-S catalyst / no pore) — canonical (og-adv), fails all five gates
Vent reference (characteristic features present) — passes all five gates
